<description>
Before eae193e750235e4023b3e6313284eede2cd7a022, Connect() only started the connection and returned true. If tor wasn't running the refusal was reported later and only logged under -debug=tor. Since eae193e750 (in v32), every failed reconnect attempt logs:

```
2026-11-04T14:14:08Z connect() to 127.0.0.1:9051 failed after wait: Connection refused (111)
2026-11-04T14:14:08Z [warning] tor: Error connecting to address 127.0.0.1:9051
2026-11-04T14:14:08Z [warning] tor: Initiating connection to Tor control port 127.0.0.1:9051 failed
```

On a default configured node without tor, this pollutes debug.log with 18 lines every hour.

This improves it
</description>

[quoted text omitted]

Sorry @fjahr I'm not trying to step on toes or take credit, I didn't intend for the author to merge my commit, I just wanted to start a discussion:

[quoted text omitted]
And since its "just" logging I'm not dying on any hill here, and just asked claude to whip up something I could test out the user experience.

So just to take it back a step, here's things I like a lot:
- (warn then debug) log the first time tor control disconnects, or on startup if its not available
- (info) log again when tor control reconnects
- (debug) move every connection retry (after the first) down a log level so its less spammy

Something I don't care about but won't oppose:
- Changing logging behavior based on user configuration (my opinion is that `debug=tor` is the only configuration this PR should react to)

Something I don't like but don't care enough to push back against if out-voted:
- setting `manual_connection=true` so that every error is logged a second time from netbase
